meta.title: SCIM User Provisioning with SSO Configuration missing or misconfigured (DEP-005)
gaps: Exercise SCIM User Provisioning to observe whether users are auto-provisioned and use password login without SSO
Observe or verify an admin-visible warning, impact, or preventive block for the missing or misconfigured SSO dependency
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Exercise SCIM User Provisioning to observe whether users are auto-provisioned and use password login without SSO; Observe or verify an admin-visible warning, impact, or preventive block for the missing or misconfigured SSO dependency

steps.note: Leave the recommended SSO dependency disabled to represent the missing or misconfigured prerequisite.
Enable the SCIM feature whose behavior is under test.

args.need: exercise SCIM User Provisioning with SSO disabled and verify whether a user is auto-provisioned, whether password login is used, or whether Procol visibly prevents or warns about the configuration

steps.note: No catalog step can create or inspect a provisioned SCIM user or validate its login method.
Confirm the resulting screen remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester-assisted exercise.
